purpose: Schema for LATER binding of the OPWS population, executed only after Full D7 freezes. This schema file is frozen now with UNBOUND placeholders; a later binding fills only the binding fields. It may NOT change protocol semantics.

schema_fields.full_d7_evidence_commit: the Full-D7 frozen evidence commit that produced the READY census
schema_fields.full_d7_ready_population_file: path to the frozen Full-D7 READY population file
schema_fields.full_d7_ready_population_sha256: sha256 of the frozen Full-D7 READY population file
schema_fields.n_env_ready: number of environment-READY tasks in the frozen census
schema_fields.behavior_contract_manifest: path to the frozen behavior-contract manifest (adapter + evaluator contract per task)
schema_fields.n_primary_paired: number of PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE tasks (RM-CSS vs AGENT paired population)
schema_fields.ordered_task_ids: ordered, deduplicated, deterministic list of bound task IDs
schema_fields.ordered_task_ids_sha256: canonical sha256 of the ordered task-ID list
schema_fields.binding_created_at: UTC ISO timestamp when the binding record is written (after Full D7 freeze)
schema_fields.protocol_sha256: sha256 of the released OPWS protocol freeze (tag peel hash at binding time)

binding_rules: Population binding happens ONLY after Full D7 freezes AND after the Full-D7 scope/census issue is resolved AND a valid population hash is frozen (owner correction #3).
The final OPWS population is NEVER guessed. No interim binding may be created in this freeze mission.
Later bindings may fill only the schema fields; they must not change any protocol semantic, folder, estimand, seed, bootstrap, or taxonomy in this freeze.
The binding record must be self-hashed and stored under the mission artifacts so the bound identity is immutable.
Any gap between the funnel (OPWS_ELIGIBLE) and the paired population (PRIMARY_PAIRED_ELIGIBLE) must be reported task-by-task with reason codes.
If Full D7 READY count < 40, per the frozen M17 design the OPWS analysis is descriptive/supporting only; this does not change the schema.
